name: Laikou Japan Sakura Eye Cream 30ml
description:
Laikou Japan Sakura Eye Cream – 30ml

🌸 Anti-Aging | Dark Circle Remover | Hydrating Eye Care

Product Type: Eye Cream
Volume: 30ml
Origin: Made in Japan

Key Benefits:

Anti-Aging Care: Reduces fine lines & wrinkles around the eyes.

Dark Circle Remover: Brightens under-eye area for a fresh, youthful look.

Hydrates Dry Skin: Provides deep moisture to delicate eye skin.

Anti-Puffiness: Helps reduce puffiness, eye bags, and tired-looking eyes.

Lightweight & Gentle: Absorbs quickly, suitable for daily use.

Why Choose Laikou Sakura Eye Cream?

✔ Enriched with Sakura Extract for brightening & rejuvenation
✔ Smooth, lightweight texture – no greasy residue
✔ Suitable for all skin types

✅ Best For: Dark circles, fine lines, wrinkles, puffiness, eye bags
✅ Gender: Unisex (Men & Women)
